summary.en: From one row to the whole wall: the camera starts tight on one tracked row and cranes up and out until the whole window sits on the stage, rows washing with light as the frame passes them.
summary.zh: 镜头先贴着表里被追踪的那一行，再像吊臂一样升起拉远，直到整个产品窗口落在台上；画框上沿扫过的每一行亮一下，大数字随镜头计数，落定后那一行翻成完成。

fits: The first shot of an opening that starts from one concrete item and widens to the system around it: one job in a queue, one order in a ledger, one test in a run; it says "this one is part of a whole".
notFor: Products without a table or list to show; a claim that needs the title on screen from the first frame (the header is out of frame until the camera lifts); slots under about 4.5 seconds.

overlaps.note: the hand-off that pushes into a part of a page; crane-reveal goes the other way, from one row out to the whole window, and the rows react as the frame passes them

intent.en: Start on one concrete item, then widen to the system around it, so the viewer understands 'the row you just saw is one cell of a whole wall, and it is done'.
intent.zh: 从一个具体条目起，再拉开到它所在的整个系统，观众读出“刚才那一行，只是这一整面墙的一格，而且已经完成了”。

content.en: A table of 8–12 rows, each a name (en ≤ 16 chars, zh ≤ 6) and a state (en ≤ 9, zh ≤ 4), one row tracked; an eyebrow, a title (en ≤ 18, zh ≤ 8), a caption (en ≤ 34, zh ≤ 14) and a counting number (≤ 8 chars) with its label.
content.zh: 一张 8–12 行的表，每行一个名称（英文 ≤ 16 字符，中文 ≤ 6 字）和一个状态（英文 ≤ 9，中文 ≤ 4），其中一行被追踪；一行眉标、一个标题（英文 ≤ 18，中文 ≤ 8）、一句说明（英文 ≤ 34，中文 ≤ 14）和一个会计数的数字（≤ 8 字符）及其标签。

fits.zh: 从一个具体条目出发、拉开到它所在系统的开场第一镜：队列里的一个任务、账本里的一笔订单、一次运行里的一个测试；意思是“这一个只是整体的一部分”。

notFor.zh: 没有表格或列表可展示的产品；第一帧就要标题在屏的主张（镜头升起前表头在画外）；短于约 4.5 秒的槽位。

pairs.note: the counted number lands as the result

en: The opening close-up magnifies one row about 3×; rasterise real material at high resolution or the first frame is blurred.
Blur only the fast first half of the lift; blurring the slow top softens the text.
Do not use it in the same film as a top-down dive onto one item; the mirrored move reads as the same trick.
zh: 开场特写把一行放大约 3 倍；真实素材要高分辨率栅格化，否则第一帧就糊。
运动模糊只给拉升的前半段快速部分；临顶慢速段加了会把字抹软。
别和“从全局俯冲到一个点”的镜头同片并用；一升一降互为镜像，读作同一招。

upstream.name: 吊臂升起揭示
upstream.summary: 升降臂拉升揭示——开场怼在一行数据特写，相机沿 Y 轴减速升起后拉，行行涌入直到整面 dashboard 铺满全幅
upstream.use: "从细节到全局"的开场定场；与 drone-dive-landing（全局→单点俯冲）互为反向
upstream.energy: 中高（持续单向运动，无冲击拍）
